broker.name: Exclusive Markets
broker.tagline: Its site names FSA (Seychelles). Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:4000.
broker.about: The Exclusive Markets pages checked on 11 October 2026 do not state a founding year or one headquarters. Account names on its site include Exclusive, Standard Plus, Standard, Cent, and Shares. Platforms named there include MetaTrader 4 and MetaTrader 5. The site names these regulators: FSA (Seychelles). The company on an account depends on where the client lives. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:4000. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.
broker.regulators_note: The company behind an account depends on where you live. FSA (Seychelles): Exclusive Markets Ltd, SD-031.

leverage.note: Homepage says margin requirements may vary between symbols and servers.

broker.leverage_note: Leverage increases losses as well as gains, and you can lose more than you deposit. The highest figure on this card is the highest number this broker advertises. It is not the cap on every account. The cap depends on the company, the product and where you live.

other_fees.label: Minimum deposit
other_fees.note: Direct fetch of the homepage left the Exclusive minimum deposit line blank and did not print the other account minimums. A search extract of the same homepage listed Exclusive $1000, Standard Plus $500, Standard $100, Cent $10 and Shares $5000. Those figures are not treated as confirmed.

other_fees.label: Funding commission
other_fees.note: Homepage funding section says zero commission. It does not define card or bank charges.

_notes.fetch_notes: Homepage fetch worked and included account spreads, leverage, stop-out and the $15 per lot IB line. Direct fetches of /regulations, /trading-accounts, /trading-accounts/exclusive, /leverage-margin and the Spanish Exclusive page returned only the support email, so commission, deposit amounts and the dynamic leverage tier table were not confirmed from a rendered page. Search extracts of those URLs included Exclusive commission $7 per lot and a forex tier starting at 1:4000, and a Spanish extract both listed $7 and said the Exclusive account charges no commission. Those conflicts are left unverified. Client agreement PDF fetched. Privacy notice search extract also says Reg. No. 8423950-1 and FSA licence SD031. Copy Trading and PAMM are named on the homepage as services, not as extra account types with prices.
_notes.company_details_not_listed: Client agreement header: Exclusive Markets Ltd, Seychelles Reg. No. 8423950-1, Suite 18, Third Floor, Vairam Building, Providence, Mahe, Seychelles. Clause 1.2 prints registration number 8423950 and FSA authorization SD-031 at the same address. A search extract of the MT4 web terminal prints a different registration number, 843950-1, and licence SD031. The client agreement number is used here.
